scenes.title:
Pick up the work.
Not the explanation.
scenes.subtitle: A reviewed session handoff - demonstrated locally
scenes.caption: Screenshot walkthrough. Local transport, not a cloud deployment.
scenes.narration: How can a teammate pick up an agent investigation without starting over? This is Agent Context Across Platform, demonstrated with a local session handoff.

scenes.title: Can someone else continue my session?
scenes.subtitle: Keep the context. Keep the boundaries.
cards:
What was the task?
What did we already try?

Where did it stop?
What should happen next?

Which evidence is missing?
Whose permissions apply?
scenes.caption: A good handoff preserves uncertainty as well as progress.
scenes.narration: An unfinished investigation has a goal, earlier attempts, open questions, and access limits. A useful handoff should preserve all four, not just a confident summary.

scenes.title: Share once. Continue with context.
scenes.subtitle: A simpler experience for both people
cards:
Install once.
Share in one reviewed action.

Open the handoff.
Continue in a local agent.

Authorized access.
Human review and consent.
scenes.caption: UX goal: minimal additional setup, never permission-free access.
scenes.narration: The target is one reviewed share action for the sender and a simple starting point for the recipient. Access, authentication, and human consent still matter.

scenes.title: Transfer the context, not the credentials.
scenes.subtitle: One approval pipeline, with a local test transport
scenes.caption: A snapshot is not a copy of the source machine, permissions, or model state.
scenes.narration: Capture the selected context, redact sensitive material, review the exact bundle, and publish a snapshot. The receiving agent treats it as historical reference, not permission to replay commands.

scenes.title: Start with the task that needs a handoff.
scenes.subtitle: The captured state includes unfinished work and missing evidence
scenes.caption: This initial screenshot shows OneDrive intent. The demonstrated publish is local.
scenes.narration: The flow begins with a share request for the current investigation. This first screen shows OneDrive intent, not a completed cloud upload. The demonstration then uses local transport.

scenes.title: Make the intended audience explicit.
scenes.subtitle: A recipient-selection prompt for the cloud path
scenes.caption: No cloud recipient grant or identity enforcement is demonstrated by localhost.
scenes.narration: The proposed cloud path asks for specific recipients. This is an audience-selection prompt. It does not mean the local endpoint has authenticated a recipient or granted cloud access.

scenes.title: Review before anything is published.
scenes.subtitle: Scope, omissions, destination and approval are visible
scenes.caption: Provider: local. Secret detection is best effort; the human decides.
scenes.narration: The review explicitly shows the local provider and omitted material. Secret detection is only an aid. Publication waits for the human to approve the exact contents and destination.

scenes.title: A local snapshot is ready to hand off.
scenes.subtitle: The recorded result is a JSON summary and a localhost link
scenes.caption: The link works only on the serving machine. It is not an internet-sharing link.
scenes.narration: After approval, the agent reports a local JSON snapshot and link. This is a reviewed summary, not the complete live runtime, and the localhost address works only on this machine.

scenes.title: Resume with a local target and workspace.
scenes.subtitle: The recorded request selects Copilot and the recipient's workspace
scenes.caption: Historical context is data. Source credentials and tool permissions do not transfer.
scenes.narration: The recipient supplies the local link and selects Copilot and a workspace. Historical context can be imported, but source credentials, permissions, and tool connections do not transfer.

scenes.title: Pick up the investigation - with its limits.
scenes.subtitle: Recorded agent output, not an independent validation claim
scenes.caption: The screenshot reports a match. Cached rankings followed HTTP 403. SQL was not run.
scenes.narration: The recorded output reports restored context and a dataset match. It also discloses an access denial: popularity statistics came from cached rankings. No SQL was run.

scenes.title: Move from local proof to policy-aligned sharing.
scenes.subtitle: A future rollout gate, not a compliance certification
cards:
Approved tenant and app.
Recipient-owned identity.
Specific-people access.

Minimal capture and redaction.
Explicit review.
Respect labels and restrictions.

Audit and lifecycle policy.
Expiry and revocation.
Live cross-user validation.
scenes.caption: The provider adapter exists; secure tenant rollout and compliance review remain ahead.
scenes.narration: Next is secure, policy-aligned sharing through SharePoint and OneDrive. That requires approved identity, scoped recipients, data controls, and live tenant validation. Compliance is not established by this local demo.
